d:
We are crossing Africa coast to coast on motorbikes. In the mountains of Lesotho, a wrong turn led Cam and me down a road where riders before us had to be rescued and a Land Rover sat stuck for months.
This is Episode 16 of Lost Way Round Africa - our mission to cross the African continent coast to coast and experience everything that happens along the way.
